## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why it belongs in Tunless.

## Validation

- [ ] `go test -race ./...`
- [ ] `go vet ./...`
- [ ] Relevant privileged, container, macOS, or Windows validation was run or its absence is stated
- [ ] Documentation and measurements distinguish observed results from untested claims
- [ ] No credentials, signing material, generated build directories, or release artifacts are committed

## Security and compatibility

Describe changes to privileges, cgroups/namespaces, BPF/WFP/Network Extension hooks, network exposure, persistent state, and supported platform floors. Write “none” when not applicable.
